created_prompt: Create a realistic 3 year plan where I can grow the online following from 1.2m followers for my healthy recipe cooking and also schedule in the writing and publishing of a cookbook to compliment my cooking videos. Don't forget I have only 3 days a week to accomplish this so I need to be able to create healthy but easy to create film and photograph recipes that don't cost too much. Also cost and evaluate whether I should approach a publishing house or self publish.
